neighbours.label: Concessive ' even' introducing a condition under which an effect still occurs (occurs even when, would happen even if), vs ' even' as an adjective or intensifier
fire: In these rats, blood pressure rises even when salt intake is kept low.
The bacteria keep growing even when the temperature drops below freezing.
Symptoms can appear even when the virus is no longer detectable.
Sea levels would continue to rise even if all emissions stopped today.
The plants flower even when they receive only a few hours of light.
Tumors returned in some patients even after the drug was stopped.
Memory loss occurs even when the lesion is very small.
The glacier keeps shrinking even in years with heavy snowfall.
quiet: The floor was sanded until the surface was smooth and even.
Divide the class into two even groups for the game.
The second movie was even funnier than the first.
Only even numbers appear in the second column.
The score was even at the end of the first half.
Her new novel is even longer than her last one.
Spread the frosting in an even layer over the cake.
After the trade, the two teams were roughly even.

predictions: Scientific or explanatory claims that an effect persists 'even when/if' reach 0.15-0.5; ' even' meaning flat, divisible by two, or 'still more' stays under 0.05.
notes: Card: ' even' x8 of the top 32 (would happen even if, occurs even when mice are fed), plus 'highest for', 'found among'. Probe: occurs even when the mice eat 0.468, keep rising even if 0.184, strike even if we stay 0.060; even temperament 0.019, even number 0.010, even better 0.014. Weak and variable; fire items copy the scientific 'occurs even when' frame.
